verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no registrable outbound HTTP callbacks that a programmatic consumer could subscribe to. Stream-json output (newline-delimited JSON events on stdout) and GitHub @mention integrations are adjacent features, not webhooks, so they earn no credit. Event subscription is a fair question for an agentic CLI tool, so the axis applies and the verdict is none rather than na.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks
